payload.body: The whole epic was driven through the build-review playbook AFK: opus designed (787-line panel spec), codex implemented (spark to gpt-5.4 to terra-high across Jim's live routing changes), terra+sonnet panels found 15 accepted findings (incl. a boundary-lying trainer display both caught independently), sol QA oracles caught a circular dev-test fix and an over-wager major, host drove every change in a real browser. PR #1 merged under live on-approve authority. Final: 65 tests / 3,142 asserts, four outcome paths verified at QA-predicted seeds.
